{s}I GO TO MALL{/s} I go to the mall.
lines.zh: {s}我去商场{/s}我去商场。

lines.en: I still haven’t been paid for watching Chinami and company recently, so I figure that Chika at least owes me a discreet blowjob in the bathroom or something along those lines since she can’t actually {i}pay.{/i}
lines.zh: 我最近照看 Chinami 她们的钱还没拿到手，所以我觉得 Chika 至少欠我在洗手间来一发低调的口交什么的，因为她其实{i}付不起{/i}钱。

lines.en: But hey, I’m sure a blowjob from someone like her would be valued at quite a bit and that there would be plenty of people willing to pay for such a thing if they weren’t all dying out in space.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我敢肯定像她这样的口交值不少钱，而且如果不是所有人都要在外太空死绝了，愿意为此掏钱的人肯定多的是。

lines.en: Anyway, time to fuck my fake girlfriend.
lines.zh: 总之，是时候去操我那个假女朋友了。

lines.en: scene black
scene transgression transition
scene chinamiwormparty1
: How much longer, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 还要多久，Chinami？

lines.en: : Just a minute! Chinami is having trouble tying her shoes!
lines.zh: : 马上就好！Chinami 系鞋带遇到困难了！

lines.en: : Do you need me to come in there and help you?
lines.zh: : 需要我进去帮你吗？

lines.en: : Chinami can do it! She just needs patience!
lines.zh: : Chinami 自己可以的！她只是需要耐心！

lines.en: : Okay! Just let me know if-
lines.zh: : 好吧！要是需要就告诉我——

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty2
: Oh, hey! I didn’t even notice you there.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿！我都没注意到你在那儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, I kind of just show up sometimes.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我有时候就是会突然出现。

lines.en: : Hey, if there’s anybody I want to just randomly pop up throughout the day, it’s you. So you’re not going to hear any complaints from me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，要说有谁是我希望一整天都随随便便冒出来的，那就是你。所以我这儿你可听不到半句抱怨。

lines.en: : What’s Chinami doing here?
lines.zh: : Chinami 在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty3
: Just trying on some clothes and stuff. Yumi hasn’t come back yet, so she’s been alone a lot lately and it’s been a little while since the last time I brought her here.
lines.zh: : 就是试试衣服什么的。Yumi 还没回来，所以她最近经常一个人待着，而且我也有一阵子没带她来这儿了。

lines.en: : Figured I might as well buy her some new clothes while I’m at it.
lines.zh: : 想着既然来了，不如顺便给她买几件新衣服。

lines.en: : From here? I didn’t realize you were suddenly rich.
lines.zh: : 从这家店买？我都不知道你突然发财了。

lines.en: : Oh, no. Not from here. We bought her a new outfit from The Gap. But she still wanted to try on some of the clothes here so she could feel fancy.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。不是从这儿买的。我们在 The Gap 给她买了一套新衣服。不过她还想试试这儿的衣服，好让自己感觉很时髦。

lines.en: : Chinami! Are you almost done? Sensei wants to say hi!
lines.zh: : Chinami！你快好了吗？Sensei 想跟你打招呼！

lines.en: : Actually, I was kind of hoping we could be {i}alone{/i} today if you catch my drift?
lines.zh: : 其实，我有点希望我们今天能{i}单独{/i}待一会儿，你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty4
: Here? But I thought you said stuff like that was too risky and that you wanted to slow down?
lines.zh: : 在这儿？可你不是说那种事风险太大，而且你想放慢一点吗？

lines.en: : Yes, well I didn’t have a raging erection when I said that.
lines.zh: : 是说过，可我说那话的时候并没有硬得发疼。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty5
: Well, save that thing for later and come visit me again when my kid sister isn’t literally ten feet away. There’s no way I can get away right now.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿就先留着吧，等我妹妹不是就在十英尺开外的时候你再来找我。现在我根本走不开。

lines.en: : Worst girlfriend ever.
lines.zh: : 史上最差女朋友。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty6
: Oh, I’ll make it up to you. Don’t worry at all, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦，我会补偿你的。一点都不用担心，Sensei。

lines.en: : The truth is that I’ve also been craving your thick-
lines.zh: : 其实我也一直很想要你那根又粗又——

lines.en: : Chinami is back!
lines.zh: : Chinami 回来了！

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty7
: Meatloaf!
lines.zh: : 烘肉卷！

lines.en: : Nice cover.
lines.zh: : 掩护得不错。

lines.en: : I didn’t know future Daddy could make meatloaf.
lines.zh: : 我不知道未来的爸爸会做烘肉卷。

lines.en: : How come he never brings his thick meatloaf to our house?
lines.zh: : 他为什么从来不带他那又粗又大的烘肉卷来我们家？

lines.en: : I didn’t like that sentence at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不喜欢那句话。

lines.en: : Chinami, please don’t say “thick meatloaf” anymore.
lines.zh: : Chinami，请你别再说「又粗又大的烘肉卷」了。

lines.en: : But big sister Chika sounded so excited when she was talking about Papa's thick meatloaf.
lines.zh: : 可是 Chika 姐姐说起爸爸那又粗又大的烘肉卷时听起来好兴奋啊。

lines.en: : Chinami, stop it.
lines.zh: : Chinami，别说了。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty8
: Wait, where is your helmet?! What do you think you’re doing coming out here without it on?! You could get sick.
lines.zh: : 等等，你的头盔呢？！你以为你在干什么，没戴它就跑出来？！你会生病的。

lines.en: : But it’s so hot! Chinami is literally dying while she’s inside the helmet.
lines.zh: : 可是太热了！Chinami 戴着头盔真的要死了。

lines.en: : Technically, we’re all “literally dying” every second of every day.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我们每时每刻都在「真的要死」。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty9
: We are?! That’s Bad News Bears!
lines.zh: : 我们也是？！那真是坏消息熊！

lines.en: : Did you just wake up today and decide to do everything within your power to make my life harder?
lines.zh: : 你是今天一觉醒来，决定要不遗余力地让我日子更难过吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. If that were true, I’d have shown up here with my arm wrapped around Yumi.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。如果真是那样，我就会搂着 Yumi 出现在这儿了。

lines.en: : Hope you’re ready to fight off the Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 那祝你准备好对付黑道了。

lines.en: : That’s even more Bad News Bears! Chinami knows something like that is called an affair now!
lines.zh: : 那更是坏消息熊了！Chinami 知道那种事现在叫外遇！

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty10
: How does Chinami know that?!
lines.zh: : Chinami 怎么会知道那个？！

lines.en: : Because Tsukasa’s big sister is having an affair with everyone in town!
lines.zh: : 因为 Tsukasa 的姐姐跟镇上每个人都有一腿！

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty11
: She is? But she seems so innocent.
lines.zh: : 是吗？可她看起来那么单纯。

lines.en: : It’s totally crazy! And really Bad News Bears!
lines.zh: : 简直疯了！而且真的是坏消息熊！

lines.en: : Why is Chinami’s catch phrase suddenly the title of a 1970’s baseball film?
lines.zh: : 为什么 Chinami 的口头禅突然变成了一部七十年代棒球电影的片名？

lines.en: : Where did you hear that, Chinami? Did Tsukasa tell you? Because there’s barely ever any gossip I’m not in on and-
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿听来的，Chinami？是 Tsukasa 告诉你的吗？因为几乎没有什么是我不知情的八卦，而且——

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty12
: Wait a second! Stop talking and go get your helmet!
lines.zh: : 等一下！别说了，去把头盔拿回来！

lines.en: : Chinami is sorry! Please don’t have an affair while she’s gone!
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道错了！她不在的时候请不要外遇！

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty13
Chinami darts back into the dressing room, leaving me outside with both Chika and my raging hard-on (Yes, it is still there).
lines.zh: Chinami 飞奔回试衣间，把我和 Chika、还有我那根硬得发疼的鸡巴留在外面（是的，它还在那儿硬着）。

lines.en: : Sensei...why is my little sister suddenly talking about things she shouldn’t understand the meaning of for at least another...five thousand years?
lines.zh: : Sensei……为什么我妹妹突然开始聊起那些她至少再过……五千年都不该懂的东西？

lines.en: : It’s gotta be the Tsukiokas. They’re bad influences, I tell you.
lines.zh: : 肯定是 Tsukioka 家的人。我跟你说，她们就是坏影响。

lines.en: : I’ll try to find time to scold Touka in between her apparent bang sessions with all of my neighbors.
lines.zh: : 我会设法在 Touka 跟我所有邻居的性爱场次之间挤出时间来训她一顿。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty14
: Chinami is back and doggier than ever.
lines.zh: : Chinami 回来了，而且比以往更像小狗。

lines.en: : I don’t think your “dog” level has increased just because you got a new outfit.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你换了一身新衣服，你的「狗」程度就提升了。

lines.en: : Right! Chinami got a new outfit! What do you think, future Daddy? Is Chinami super cute?
lines.zh: : 对哦！Chinami 有新衣服了！你觉得呢，未来的爸爸？Chinami 超级可爱吧？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然。为什么不呢？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t she be cuter {i}without{/i} the helmet?
lines.zh: : 她{i}不{/i}戴头盔不是更可爱吗？

lines.en: : The helmet stays on, Chinami. I don’t want you getting sick and you’ve already been exposed to more people than normal lately.
lines.zh: : 头盔必须戴着，Chinami。我不想你生病，而且你最近接触的人已经比平常多了。

lines.en: : That’s okay! Tsukasa’s big sister washed her hands many, many times while she was at the house! She did it after almost everything she touched! It was really weird.
lines.zh: : 没关系！Tsukasa 的姐姐在我们在家的时候洗了好多次手！她几乎碰到什么就洗一次！真的很奇怪。

lines.en: : I think that was just Touka’s inherent lack of knowledge in the face of poverty compelling her to practice better hygiene when in places she expects to be less...clean.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那只是 Touka 天生对贫穷缺乏认知，所以到了她觉得不那么……干净的地方，就会更注重卫生。

lines.en: : Maybe! Chinami only understood half of that sentence, so she doesn’t really know.
lines.zh: : 也许吧！Chinami 只听懂了半句，所以其实不太清楚。

lines.en: : Are you hungry yet, Chinami? It’s about time for me to go on break. And I still need to pay Sensei back for watching you the other day, so I can get him lunch while we’re out as well.
lines.zh: : 你饿了吗，Chinami？差不多该到我休息的时间了。而且我还得报答 Sensei 那天照顾你，所以出去的时候也可以顺便请他吃午饭。

lines.en: : I was kind of hoping {i}the other thing{/i} would be my payment.
lines.zh: : 我倒是有点希望{i}另一样东西{/i}才是给我的报酬。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty15
: You mean the thing I will do literally whenever, {i}wherever{/i} so long as there isn’t a girl wearing a dog mask several feet away from us?
lines.zh: : 你是说那件我真的随时随地、{i}在哪儿{/i}都愿意做的事，只要离我们几英尺外没有一个戴着狗面具的女孩？

lines.en: : Chinami, take off the mask. It’s for a good cause.
lines.zh: : Chinami，把面具摘了。这是为了一件好事。

lines.en: : If that’s what future Daddy says, Chinami has to listen!
lines.zh: : 既然未来的爸爸这么说，Chinami 就得听话！

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty16
: Don’t you dare. You so much as reach for that mask and I’m taking you to the kennel.
lines.zh: : 你敢。你只要伸手去碰那个面具，我就把你送去狗舍。

lines.en: : But the other dogs don’t like Chinami! She’s too big and hasn’t learned their language yet!
lines.zh: : 可是别的狗不喜欢 Chinami！她太大只了，而且还没学会它们的语言！

lines.en: scene black
Begrudgingly, Chinami keeps the mask on as Chika clocks out for her break and begins to lead us over to the mall’s food court.
lines.zh: Chinami 不情不愿地继续戴着面具，Chika 则打卡下班，开始带我们往商场的美食广场走。

lines.en: Things are a little busy once we get there as it seems that people from many of the other shops are starting to take their breaks as well but, despite that, no one really pays any attention to Chinami.
lines.zh: 我们到那儿时有点热闹，因为许多其他店铺的人似乎也开始休息了，不过尽管如此，并没有人真的注意到 Chinami。

lines.en: I don’t know if the novelty of seeing a little girl in a dog mask has just worn out for all of these people but, at least to me, knowing we’re not the center of attention is good.
lines.zh: 我不知道看到一个小女孩戴狗面具的新鲜感是不是已经让这些人腻了，但至少对我来说，知道我们不是众人的焦点是件好事。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty17
{b}Because that means no one will see anything I do to them.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}因为那意味着我对她们做的任何事都不会有人看到。{/b}

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty18
: If Chinami could have any superpower, it would be to drink things with her hands. That way, she wouldn’t feel completely helpless right now!
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 能拥有任何超能力，那就是用手喝水。那样她现在就不会觉得自己完全无能为力了！

lines.en: : Can’t you fit your milk inside of the helmet?
lines.zh: : 你就不能把牛奶塞进头盔里吗？

lines.en: : Last time Chinami tried that, she made a huge mess. And she doesn’t want to ruin her brand new clothes the first time she wears them.
lines.zh: : Chinami 上次试过，弄得一塌糊涂。而且她可不想第一次穿就把崭新的衣服弄脏。

lines.en: : Well, keep it on while we’re in the food court. Once our food comes, I’ll let you take the helmet off in the office at my store where I can make sure everything is safe.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在美食广场的时候就先戴着。等我们的餐来了，我让你在我店里的办公室把头盔摘下来，那儿我能确保一切安全。

lines.en: : Will Chinami ever get to come to the mall without her helmet on?
lines.zh: : Chinami 以后能不戴头盔来商场吗？

lines.en: : One day when your immune system is stronger, sure. But right now, you’re still young and shrimpy and need to be extra careful so you don’t get sick.
lines.zh: : 等哪天你的免疫系统变强了，当然可以。可现在你还小、个头也小，需要格外小心，免得生病。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t like it, but she understands.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不喜欢，但她理解。

lines.en: : She will just try to absorb the milk through osmosis so everyone can be happy.
lines.zh: : 那她就试着用渗透作用把牛奶吸收进体内，这样大家都能开心。

lines.en: : Good girl. Maybe after I get out we can go look for a mask that’s a little less hot? It’s almost October, so Spirit Halloween is probably going to be putting up shops all around our house before we know it.
lines.zh: : 乖女孩。也许等我下班后，我们可以去找一个没那么热的面具？快到十月了，所以 Spirit Halloween 大概很快就要在我们家附近开满店了。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize they were so popular in the old district.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道它们在这片旧街区这么火。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty19
: Wherever there are unused storefronts, there will {i}always{/i} be a Spirit Halloween.
lines.zh: : 只要有空着的店面，就{i}一定{/i}会有一家 Spirit Halloween。

lines.en: : Spirit Halloween, for all of your Halloween related needs.
lines.zh: : Spirit Halloween，满足你所有的万圣节需求。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty20
scene chinamiwormparty19
: Did anyone else see that just now?
lines.zh: : 刚才还有别人看到吗？

lines.en: : Hm? See what?
lines.zh: : 嗯？看到什么？

lines.en: : Chinami hasn’t seen {i}anything{/i} in ten whole minutes!
lines.zh: : Chinami 整整十分钟{i}什么{/i}都没看到！

lines.en: : Hang in there, Sensei. I’m pretty sure all of that, uhh...{i}redirected bloodflow{/i} might be making you a little lightheaded right now.
lines.zh: : 撑住啊，Sensei。我敢肯定那些，呃……{i}被重新分配的血液{/i}可能让你现在有点头晕。

lines.en: : You seem kinda pale too. Want me to get you a bottle of water or something? I’m friends with the girl working the sushi place right now so I can get you one for free if you want.
lines.zh: : 你脸色也有点苍白。要不要我去给你拿瓶水什么的？我现在跟寿司店打工的那个女孩是朋友，你要的话我可以免费拿一瓶。

lines.en: : You don’t need to-
lines.zh: : 你不用——

lines.en: : Sensei, it’s fine. I’m going to have to head over there to pick up our food in a few minutes anyway. And I have, like...zero clue what I’d do if you were to pass out in front of me.
lines.zh: : Sensei，没关系的。反正我几分钟后也得过去拿我们的餐。而且我……完全不知道要是你在我面前晕过去我该怎么办。

lines.en: : You could always help re-{i}re{/i}-redirect some of my bloodflow, Chika. That would probably help a little more than water.
lines.zh: : 你也可以帮我重新{i}再{/i}分配一下血液嘛，Chika。那大概比水更管用一点。

lines.en: : Would it really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的会更管用吗？

lines.en: : {s}Fuck me while she can’t see us.{/s} Yes.
lines.zh: : {s}趁她看不见的时候干我。{/s}是的。

lines.en: : Would it really though?
lines.zh: : 真的会更管用吗？

lines.en: : {s}I will wrap my hands around your throat and make your eyes roll back.{/s} Yes.
lines.zh: : {s}我会用双手掐住你的脖子，让你的眼珠子翻白。{/s}是的。

lines.en: : Would it really though?
lines.zh: : 真的会更管用吗？

lines.en: : {s}DO YOU think I WILL NOT take you here???{/s} Yes.
lines.zh: : {s}你觉得我不会就在这儿要了你？？？{/s}是的。

lines.en: : {b}WILL IT REALLY THOUGH???????????????{/b}
: {s}DO YOU THINK I WILL NOT TAKE HER AS WELL???{/s} Yes.
lines.zh: : {s}你觉得我不会连她一起要了？？？{/s}是的。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty21
: Arf!
: Huh? Where did Chika go?
lines.zh: : 哈？Chika 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Big sis Chika went to go get you water. Chinami decided to bark since you weren’t saying anything.
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐去给你拿水了。Chinami 看你一句话都不说，就决定叫两声。

lines.en: : You need to be careful, future Daddy. She might make you start wearing a mask soon too if you don’t start acting like you’re okay!
lines.zh: : 你得小心点，未来的爸爸。要是你再不表现得正常一点，她可能很快也要让你戴上口罩了！

lines.en: : I...think I’ll be fine without a mask, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我不戴面具也没事，Chinami。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks she’ll be fine without a mask too!
lines.zh: : Chinami 也觉得自己不戴面具也没事！

lines.en: : Too bad that Chinami has to-
lines.zh: : 可惜 Chinami 还是得——

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty22
: Gehh...
lines.zh: : 咳呃……

lines.en: Oh no. I’m the bad parent.
lines.zh: 哦不。我是个坏家长。

lines.en: : Chinami...is finally free...
lines.zh: : Chinami……终于自由了……

lines.en: : Chinami, you’re going to get {i}both{/i} of us in trouble if you don’t put that back on.
lines.zh: : Chinami，你要是不把它戴回去，会让我们{i}俩{/i}都惹上麻烦的。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty23
: I seriously can’t do it anymore! It’s too hot and I’m going to pass out if I stay in there any longer!
lines.zh: : 我真的受不了了！太热了，再待在里面我就要晕过去了！

lines.en: : There’s nobody else around! At least let me breathe for a few seconds until Onee-chan comes back!
lines.zh: : 周围又没有别人！至少让我呼吸几秒钟，等姐姐回来再说！

lines.en: : Who are you and why are you talking like that?
lines.zh: : 你是谁，为什么突然这么说话？

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty24
: Arf?
: I’m...going to ignore that momentary lapse in character and chalk it up to the early stages of heatstroke. So...fine.
lines.zh: : 我……打算无视这次短暂的人设崩坏，把它归咎于中暑的前兆。那么……好吧。

lines.en: : You can keep it off. But as soon as Chika turns around, you’re putting it back on. I am not risking my {i}plans{/i} for later tonight just because you think it’s important to {i}breathe.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你可以继续摘着。但 Chika 一转身，你就得戴回去。我可不会因为你觉得{i}呼吸{/i}很重要，就拿我今晚的{i}计划{/i}去冒险。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty25
: Chinami thanks you for your kindness, future Daddy. She promises she won’t ask you what your plans for later tonight are either.
lines.zh: : Chinami 谢谢你的好心，未来的爸爸。她保证也不会问你今晚的计划是什么。

lines.en: : Good because I have no idea how I would even explain them to you.
lines.zh: : 那就好，因为我完全不知道该怎么跟你解释。

lines.en: : Chinami is smarter than she looks, you know. She can do ten times ten in her head. She can even say her phone number with her eyes closed.
lines.zh: : Chinami 可比看起来聪明哦。她能心算十乘十。她甚至能闭着眼睛背出自己的电话号码。

lines.en: : That last one isn’t that impressive.
lines.zh: : 最后那个也没多厉害。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty26
: Chinami doesn’t like when future Daddy doesn’t believe she’s super awesome and smart.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不喜欢未来的爸爸不相信她又厉害又聪明。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} don’t like being repeatedly referred to as “future Daddy” despite having no real intention of becoming your father.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}也不喜欢被反复叫作「未来的爸爸」，尤其我根本没打算真当你爸爸。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks this is called a crossroads and that we should both agree to talk about something more fun. Like giraffes or rabbits.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得这就叫十字路口，我们应该说好聊点更有趣的东西。比如长颈鹿或者兔子。

lines.en: : How about we talk about why you’re suddenly tired of your helmet when I thought you loved it?
lines.zh: : 那我们聊聊吧——我以为你很喜欢你的头盔，怎么突然就受不了了？

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty27
: Chinami does love her dog helmet! She just wishes it had air conditioning!
lines.zh: : Chinami 是很喜欢她的狗狗头盔！她只是希望它能装个空调！

lines.en: : Do you even watch the news?! This is supposed to be the hottest summer ever! Get your head out of the super hot clouds and read a paper or something!
lines.zh: : 你到底看不看新闻啊？！据说这是有史以来最热的夏天！把你的脑袋从滚烫的云里拔出来，去看份报纸什么的！

lines.en: : No one reads the paper anymore, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 现在没人看报纸了，Chinami。

lines.en: : No wonder why society is collapsing!
lines.zh: : 难怪社会要崩溃了！

lines.en: : I think the collapse of society runs a little deeper than the death of print, but that’s not something I should be getting into with a literal child.
lines.zh: : 我觉得社会的崩塌比纸质媒体的消亡要更深一层，不过这不是我该跟一个货真价实的小孩讨论的事。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty28
: Arf. Arf arf arf. Arf arf arf arf.
lines.zh: : 汪。汪汪汪。汪汪汪汪。

lines.en: : What are you saying right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在在说什么？

lines.en: : Chinami is discussing climate change with her disembodied head. She does this sometimes when she feels there aren’t enough intellectuals around.
lines.zh: : Chinami 在跟她那个脱离身体的脑袋讨论气候变化。她觉得周围聪明人不够的时候就会这样。

lines.en: : Wow, I sure hope Chika comes back soon so you can go back to not breathing.
lines.zh: : 哇，我真希望 Chika 快点回来，好让你重新回到不能呼吸的状态。

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty29
: Do you really think it’s fair that Chinami has to wear this {i}all{/i} the time? She understands what’s safe and when to be careful.
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得让 Chinami{i}一直{/i}都戴着这玩意儿公平吗？她知道什么是安全的，也知道什么时候该小心。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}all{/i} the time, it’s just...whenever you’re out in public. And it’s for your own good, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}一直{/i}啦，只是……只要你在公共场合。而且这也是为了你好，不是吗？

lines.en: : What good is a life that’s no fun?! Chinami wants to see what everybody else sees so that she doesn’t have any regrets when she’s finally gone! And Chinami can’t see anything in there!
lines.zh: : 一点都不快乐的人生有什么意义？！Chinami 想看看别人都能看到的东西，这样等她终于离开的时候才不会后悔！可 Chinami 在里面什么都看不见！

lines.en: : It’s far too early to talk about being {i}gone,{/i} Chinami. Like Chika said, your immune system could get stronger one day and-
lines.zh: : 现在谈{i}离开{/i}还太早了，Chinami。就像 Chika 说的，你的免疫系统说不定哪天就会变强，而且——

lines.en: : But what if it doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 可要是一直不变强呢？

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty30
: What if I stay weak forever?
lines.zh: : 要是我永远都这么虚弱呢？

lines.en: : What if I live my whole life never knowing what it’s like to be a normal girl?
lines.zh: : 要是我这辈子都不知道当一个普通女孩是什么感觉呢？

lines.en: : What if-
lines.zh: : 要是——

lines.en: scene chinamiwormparty31
: Ah! Big sis Chika! Chinami must hide!
lines.zh: : 啊！Chika 姐姐！Chinami 得躲起来！

lines.en: scene black
Chinami quickly shoves the dog helmet back on top of her head just seconds before Chika looks up from the tray carrying all of our lunches.
lines.zh: 就在 Chika 从端着我们所有午餐的托盘上抬起头来的几秒前，Chinami 迅速把狗头盔重新扣回了头上。

lines.en: When she returns to the table, she thanks Chinami for being such a good girl and listening to her big sister.
lines.zh: 她回到桌边时，感谢 Chinami 这么乖、这么听姐姐的话。

lines.en: She offers to buy her ice cream on the way home and I have to nod and agree with everything Chika says so Chinami’s secret stays safe.
lines.zh: 她提出回家的路上给她买冰淇淋，而我只能对 Chika 说的每一句话点头附和，好保住 Chinami 的秘密。

lines.en: Or at least {i}one{/i} of her secrets.
lines.zh: 或者至少保住{i}其中一个{/i}秘密。

lines.en: Among the sea of noise pouring from the mall’s loudspeakers, I hear something on the way back to the boutique.
lines.zh: 在商场广播倾泻而出的一片噪音中，回精品店的路上我听到了一点什么。

lines.en: A stifled cough, silenced by the head of a dog.
lines.zh: 一声被狗头闷住的咳嗽。

lines.en: And a reactive “arf” to hide it.
lines.zh: 以及一声为了掩饰它而发出的「汪」。
